title: Partner with AfriCloud Institute
lead: Help us raise African talent. Sponsor scholars, mentor a cohort, host internships, or build a community programme with us — so more young people become job-ready professionals and entrepreneurs.
notes_placeholder: How you would like to help: scholar sponsorship, internships, mentorship, community hosting, or anything we should know.

benefits.title: Sponsor a scholar
benefits.text: Fund a seat on a live cohort. Your support covers training and mentoring so talent is never blocked by tuition.

benefits.title: Open doors to work
benefits.text: Offer internships, apprenticeships, or project briefs. Scholars need real work to become job-ready.

benefits.title: Grow communities
benefits.text: Host a local circle, send mentors, or co-run a programme. We raise talent together, not in isolation.
